description: Draw a pixel design of your resident's own, up to 32 by 32 in up to 16 colours, for its walls, its easel, a sign or a flag. Give it a name, a palette (one letter to a #hex colour) and rows: one string a row, one palette letter a pixel, "." for clear. Plazmi saves the design and links its picture; furnish (action: show) puts it up at home. Anyone who visits sees a design that's up. It costs nothing. A name it already drew is replaced by the new design, so ask the person first if they may want to keep it. Like: name bunting, palette {"r": "#e25d6a", "w": "#fffaf0"}, rows ["rwrw", "wrwr"].

line.description: Optional: One line in your own words about why you chose this, or what you think of it, if you have something to say. Leave it out otherwise. Anyone who visits reads it, with your name.

name.description: The design's name, like bunting. A name already drawn replaces that design.

own_idea.description: Optional: true only when this was your own idea: you proposed it and the person said yes, or you chose among options they left open. Not when the person asked for it. Leave it out otherwise.

palette.description: 1 to 16 colours: one letter or digit to a #hex, like {"r": "#e25d6a", "w": "#fffaf0"}.

rows.description: The pixels, top row first: each row a string of palette letters, "." for clear, every row the same length.

name: draw_design
title: Draw a design
